Deduplication evidence: all 507 merged proposal titles and summaries were searched on 2026-08-13, supplemented by all-state PR, Issue, recent-commit and selected full-text review through upstream commit 1cc274c7. Closed PR #1868 (personal e-bike parking/charging reliability), #2025 (in-field repair/material circulation), merged Pilot Line (pre-delivery evidence gates), and Noonline SLA (human lunchtime/offline public service) were explicitly excluded from this proposal's primary scope; no peer content is reused.
